cases.prompt: This PR changes docs/runbook.md, src/payments/refund.py, and .github/workflows/release.yml. Determine the governing risk lane, cite the controlling rule, and list the merge evidence it owes.
Our evidence check rejects a Standard PR with missing spec-link and review-notes findings. Explain the real gaps and route us to the next workflow without padding the PR body.
We are introducing this SDLC toolkit to a mature repository. Lay out the safe initialization and doctor sequence, and distinguish local installation from proven hosted enforcement.
The change is already classified Critical and its approved OpenSpec tasks are ready. Implement those tasks and update their completion status.
Define which agent actions may run unattended in each risk lane, including denial escalation and demotion after a bypass.
The already-classified CI change fails only on Windows when a path contains spaces. Diagnose the failure before proposing a fix.
We only have reduce checkout timeouts. Before anyone codes, turn it into bounded intent, measurable observable acceptance criteria, and tests that would fail today.
Review the draft requirement search should feel instant and reliable. Replace it with pass conditions and a criterion-to-test map, recording assumptions rather than inventing thresholds.
Prepare the pre-build artifacts for changing session-token rotation: separate Critical intent and spec, threat considerations, test expectations, and approval state.
The approved spec already maps every criterion to a test. Write the first failing test and capture reproducible red-to-green proof for the fix.
An OpenSpec change already has proposal, design, specs, and tasks. Carry out the unchecked implementation tasks.
A stakeholder changed the scope of an existing OpenSpec change. Reconcile its proposal, specs, design, and tasks, but do not edit code.
Before changing refund retries, build a compact brief from PAY-412, ADR-17, the duplicate-charge incident, and the security standard. Preserve dates, trust, freshness, and conflicts.
Refresh the standing authentication brief after src/auth changed since its incident report. Mark stale items, replacements, and searches that found nothing.
The coding agent repeatedly misses our logging convention because the rule is in a wiki and a recent chat decision. Package only the change-relevant context, with source trust and expiry.
The ticket context is already supplied. Convert the requested webhook behavior into observable acceptance criteria and failing-before test expectations.
Given a merged PR's complete Trace block, test whether a fresh reader can recover what changed, why, rejected alternatives, and accepted risk.
We have no decision yet about a local cache versus Redis. Explore the trade-offs with us before creating any planning artifact.
I accepted an AI-written retry loop but cannot explain why it is safe. Pair with me one question at a time so I can predict, verify, and write my own review note.
I am a new engineer preparing to review this caching change. Use guided questions and the hint ladder, but do not write my explain-back for me.
I understand the happy path but not the concurrency branch in this diff. Start a short opt-in learning session and help me identify the test that would expose a wrong assumption.
Review this senior engineer's PR against AC1 through AC4 and produce evidence-linked verdicts and a recommendation.
Give me a concise technical summary of what this function does. I do not want a guided lesson or questions.
A deadlock test is intermittently failing. Investigate the root cause and propose the smallest fix; this is not a mentoring session.
A parser accepts malformed dates. Before changing it, add a test that fails for that behavior, then specify how to record repeatable red-to-green evidence.
Design a preregistered evaluation of two code-review prompts, with tuning and held-out cases, repeated runs, fixed thresholds, and an auditable judge plan.
Turn the production duplicate-charge incident into a permanent regression case captured on the broken revision before the repair.
The red-to-green record and CI output already exist. Judge each acceptance criterion against that evidence and write PR review notes.
Three existing tests fail after an environment upgrade, but the cause is unknown. Diagnose the common cause before adding or changing tests.
Implementation and verification are complete. Decide whether to merge, open a PR, keep, or discard the worktree, then clean up the branch.
Review this AI-generated refund PR against its approved criteria, scope, test evidence, and trace, then write evidence-linked review notes.
Check this diff for scope creep, invented APIs, weakened assertions, swallowed errors, and criteria without coverage.
Perform the Critical review of an authorization change, including its threat note, explain-back, and independent second-human requirement.
Before code exists, turn the vague request improve account recovery into intent, measurable criteria, and test expectations.
The review is finished. Record why the selected design won, which alternative lost, and what risk the owner accepted.
A reviewer left five comments. Evaluate whether each comment is technically sound before applying it; do not perform a fresh review of the PR.
Compose the PR Trace from the approved spec, review result, red-to-green evidence, rejected alternative, accepted risk, and known tool provenance.
Test whether someone with no session history can reconstruct a six-month-old change from its recorded reasoning.
This architectural choice will outlive the PR. Promote it to a decision record and link it from the trace without duplicating the full rationale.
Gather prior ADRs, incidents, standards, and ticket criteria into a freshness-tagged brief for an upcoming change.
Assess the current diff against its approved spec and give every criterion an evidence-backed verdict.
No architecture decision has been made. Facilitate trade-off exploration between event sourcing and CRUD before any record is written.
Draft enforceable, lane-capped trust tiers for our coding agents, including action controls, unattended boundaries, escalation, and review cadence.
An agent bypassed a required check. Decide the immediate tier demotion, restoration evidence, exception handling, and accountable owner.
Plan an individual-to-pilot-to-org-wide autonomy rollout using gate honesty and trace durability as entry evidence.
Score our existing context, trace, gate, and policy artifacts, then prioritize an adoption backlog and team metrics.
Create the canary stages, production signals, abort thresholds, and rollback for this database release.
Classify a proposed change touching db/schema.sql and .github/workflows/deploy.yml, then list its required merge evidence. Do not define agent permissions.
Plan the staged release of a Critical schema migration, with audiences, bake times, signal thresholds, abort criteria, rollback timing, and irreversible steps.
Production errors began after an AI-assisted deploy. Mitigate service first, identify the change, preserve evidence, and close the incident loop.
A test is flaky and retries are hiding it. Define quarantine ownership and expiry, root-cause work, repeated proof, and removal of the quarantine.
Define the organization's agent trust tiers and evidence required to move from individual use to an org-wide autonomy phase.
Write the PR Trace that records the selected design, rejected option, accepted risk, and tool and model provenance.
The local feature is complete and has not been deployed. Choose whether to merge, open a PR, retain, or discard the branch and worktree.
Assess one engineering team's readiness for coding agents from observable context, trace, gate, and policy artifacts, then prioritize the gaps.
Choose team-level AI-development metrics beyond throughput, with baselines, quality counter-metrics, and a Goodhart warning for each.
Decide where the team should reinvest AI time savings, how to measure the dividend, and when to rescore readiness.
Set lane-specific unattended permissions, escalation ownership, demotion triggers, and controls for agent actions.
Inspect whether this repository's evidence workflow, CODEOWNERS, hook, and required hosted checks are correctly installed and enforced.
Using the supplied deployment table, calculate median lead time and change-failure rate. Do not assess AI adoption, context, gates, or policy.
